# T-1: Define canonical regression snapshots

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create the immutable snapshot value model and centralize changed-file hashing, validation, canonical ordering, serialization, and equality.

## Acceptance Criteria
- RegressionFileSnapshot and RegressionFileSnapshotList enforce the R1 invariants.
- Order-independent, one-byte, add, delete, rename, untracked-directory expansion, and deleted-file cases are covered.
- Hashing uses bounded entry count and fixed-size buffered file reads.

## Implementation Notes
Add src/flow/lib/regression-file-snapshot.js. Export the shared changed-file count limit from src/lib/git-helpers.js and make listRegressionChangedFiles request untrackedFiles=all. Replace test-regression.js fingerprint implementation with delegation so existing final-regression consumers retain array output.

## Test Strategy
Use specs/316-canonical-regression-snapshots/tests/regression-file-snapshot.test.js with `// spec: R1`; unit-test the value classes against temporary files and shuffled changed-file inputs and assert invariant failures for malformed/duplicate/legacy entries.
